criteria.measurement: Whether the first two seconds establish a concrete, understandable reason to keep watching.
Whether the selected interval contains a complete claim, reveal, resolution, or useful takeaway.
Observed speech emphasis, reaction, conflict, surprise, motion, or demonstrable emotional shift.
Whether picture and sound support the point and remain legible without private context.
Whether format, duration, context, and call to action match the named target.
Whether caption/visual plan supports muted viewing and accessibility requirements.
